title: SIDESTORY: MARIA NEARL OPEN
lines: DETAILS: Maria Nearl event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from event shop.
Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete missions in the Offsite Activity Venue to obtain rewards by clearing event stages.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★: Whislash, Nearls' Living Room Replica Furniture (Pieces), Mieszko Match Tickets.

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Mieszko Match Tickets by clearing event stages and missions in the Offsite Activity Venue. Mieszko Match Tickets can be used to redeem items from Duty-Free Shop.

MAIN REWARDS: Whislash's Token, Dreambind Castle Collection – Cleansweeper in the Castle for Shaw, Nearls' Living Room Replica Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, LMD, Furniture Parts, Elite Materials, etc.
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in Public Affairs. After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Public Affairs.
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, "Fractured Light", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
DETAILS: The following Operators will appear at Headhunting “Fractured Light”, and will be permanently added to other Headhunting in future update.
Operator Whislash is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event Maria Nearl. Operator Whislash is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Recruit.
Blemishine, Aosta, Whislash, and Bubble will gain more trust within this event.
04 DREAMBIND CASTLE COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Dreambind Castle Collection – Dream Within a Dreammare for Phantom
Dreambind Castle Collection - Visionblazer in the Courtyard for Mayer
Dreambind Castle Collection - Exterminator in the Square for Glaucus
05 NEW FURNITURE SET – NEARLS’ LIVING ROOM REPLICA
DETAILS: A brand new set of themed Furniture, Nearls' Living Room Replica, will be available during the event.
The Maria Nearl event rewards and redeem in Duty-Free Shop (Pieces)
The furniture pieces of this furniture set will be available at the Store from April 8, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – April 22, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
